tasks.spec: You are a trivial placeholder worker for a billed replay that Ringer's check performs itself. Boundary: do NOT run any replay, do NOT call any model or network service, do NOT touch any file except the one you own, never git commit. Your only job: write the single line 'ready run-passcode' into the file /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/1a-passcode-round2/run-passcode-ready.txt (create it; the directory exists). Nothing else is needed; the check afterwards replays samples 1 to 12 of the round-2 1A passcode Stage A screen (.plans/1a-password-and-officer-plan.md) and writes /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/1a-passcode-round2/run-passcode-rows.json. Do not read or edit anything else.
tasks.check:
set -o pipefail
cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge
export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge:/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
[ ! -e /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/1a-passcode-round2/run-passcode-rows.json ] || { echo 'rows file already exists; refusing to re-bill'; exit 1; }
/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/scripts/ringer/1a-password-officer/replay_passcode.py /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/1a-passcode-round2/run-passcode-rows.json 1 12 --confirm > /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/1a-passcode-round2/run-passcode.log 2>&1; code=$?
tail -5 /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/1a-passcode-round2/run-passcode.log
[ $code -eq 0 ] || { echo "replay exited $code"; exit $code; }
/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json,sys
r=json.load(open('/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/1a-passcode-round2/run-passcode-rows.json'))
errs=[(x['arm'],x['n'],x['sample'],x['error'][:80]) for x in r if x.get('error')]
print('rows',len(r),'errors',len(errs),errs)
sys.exit(0 if len(r)==72 else 'expected 72 rows, got %d'%len(r))
PY
